_note: The colours the templates were drawn in (the clean palette, Rep 5) and the tokens.json name each one follows, by where it sits: text (font, label, title, value colours), line (outlines, borders, lines), shadow (drop shadows) or fill (everything else). pbik build maps them when tokens.json has theme.recolourTemplates (gen_tokens.py sets it), so a new palette reaches what the templates bake in. A template harvested from another palette needs its own entries here.
